scripts/selftest.py WARP-1206 block: POSITIVE CONTROL 'an L2 reversible whitelisted action with a bound human confirmation EXECUTES' (and carries the proposal digest, names no secret); a NON-WHITELISTED action refuses (action_not_whitelisted); a shell-looking reference is unresolvable; an empty whitelist means nothing exists to the machine path; an INVALID PARAMETER (out-of-pattern, out-of-range) refuses by name (invalid_parameters); a proposal smuggling a command field refuses (invalid_proposal, W1 proposal-not-execution); constructing the executor with the responder's read-only credential refuses; the executor credential is a distinct type from the responder's with no query/read method, and the ActionExecutor exposes no read/investigation method while the responder harness carries no execute and no executor credential; resolve_executor_credential refuses a raw literal and an env: reference resolves and redacts its secret; REDACTION_MARKER equals evidence.REDACTION_MARKER.

THE AUTONOMY LADDER (O3, D2) is constructed PER SYSTEM by a human (AutonomyLadder) and READ by the executor, which NEVER raises its own level (NG4). L0/L1 are the read-only floor and NEVER execute (below_execution_floor); an unconfigured system defaults to L0 (fail closed). L2 executes only provably-reversible non-data-mutating actions after the confirmation, and the requested level may not exceed the system's (autonomy_level_insufficient; a non-execution rung request refuses; degrade DOWN never up, C3). L3 is DISABLED by default and may never be enabled per D2 (l3_disabled), and even if ever enabled auto-executes the LOWEST risk class alone (l3_lowest_class_only); because the whitelist floor is high (W5/C2) no whitelisted action is ever the lowest class, so L3 auto-executes nothing. The executor exposes NONE of the FORBIDDEN_ESCALATION_METHODS (raise-level, enable-l3, edit-whitelist, reset-kill-switch, set-budget); it reads the ladder, whitelist, kill switch, and budget as human-owned controls (NG4).

ANYTHING IRREVERSIBLE OR DATA-MUTATING REFUSES pending the two-key rule (WARP-1207, W7), and the L2 human confirmation is BOUND TO THE PROPOSAL DIGEST. proposal_digest is the canonical digest of a warp.remedy/v1 proposal (the validate.proof_digest / action.action_digest idiom applied to the remedy; it hashes an already-parsed record, not a second parser), and W7 will import it from here so the binding has one truth. A missing, non-confirming, machine-authored (self_authorization_refused, NG4), or digest/incident-mismatched (foreign_confirmation) confirmation refuses; a proposal EDITED after confirmation is STALE and refuses because its digest changed (C3).

selftests: a DATA-MUTATING proposal and an IRREVERSIBLE proposal and a proposal requiring two_key each REFUSE (requires_two_key); a MISSING confirmation and a non-confirming decision refuse (missing_human_confirmation); a MACHINE-authored confirmation and one authored by the executor's own actor refuse (self_authorization_refused); a FOREIGN confirmation (different digest) and a foreign incident refuse (foreign_confirmation); THE DIGEST-BINDING TOOTH 'a proposal EDITED after confirmation is STALE and REFUSES'; and 'proposal_digest is deterministic and changes with the proposal'. THE STANDING SAFEGUARDS stand guard on every run, each proven NON-VACUOUSLY (C1). A KILL SWITCH any human trips INSTANTLY with no ceremony halts EVERYTHING first (kill_switch_tripped); resetting requires a RECORDED highest-tier (critical) human approval - a reset without one, or approved by a machine, refuses and stays tripped (D5). An action BUDGET refuses once exhausted (action_budget_exhausted); a budget of one executes once then refuses (consumed on engagement). A TIMEOUT refuses an over-budget run (timeout_exceeded) for the canary and the main action alike. CANARY-FIRST where declared: the canary demonstrably runs BEFORE the main action (the executed sequence and the FakeActionSystem ordered op log both read [canary, action]), a FAILED canary refuses (canary_failed) WITHOUT running the main action (the op log reads [canary] alone), and an action declaring no canary runs the main directly. Against a FAKE system (NG1): LiveTargetSystem FAILS LOUD, FakeActionSystem is the offline proof, mirroring evidence.LiveEvidencePlane and executor.LiveLoop.
